reconstruction.scope: Specific complete mapped Forbidden City exterior: irregular palace courts and dense east/west gallery compounds; central Supreme/Central/Preserving Harmony halls on triple stone terraces; inner palaces; U-shaped Meridian Gate/five roofed pavilions; north/east/west gates; grey perimeter walls and four cross-roof corner towers. Original central stream/moat/roads remain native, with five specific stone footbridges at mapped crossings. Red walls/columns, gold swept tile roofs/teal beam belts, white stone stairs/balustrades, opaque timber door/lattice panels and grey side roofs use shared surfaces. The panels use the shared wood graph rather than generic glass; their fine lattice pattern is not reproduced. Fine architectural inventory is approximate; furnished halls, collections, inscriptions, copied artwork/banners/crowds and trees are outside this structure model.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Standard map heights/min-heights have unqualified datum. Main controls supply working central hall ridges41/32/35m, triple terraces3/6/9m, Meridian Gate roof peaks up to45m and north gate28m. These values are retained as visualization controls, not surveyed measurements. Unqualified smaller buildings use footprint-led picture estimates; generic lower roofs, bays, ridge ornaments, roof-tier/railing/column inventories and absent gate arch dimensions remain approximate. Five photographs from1991/2017/2018 establish visible form, not current condition or a certified room/roof inventory. Ceremonial floor datum-6.288943978990174m comes from the original southern plaza samples rather than the roof-influenced anchor; triple terrace heights and central hall profiles are relative to that working floor.
reconstruction.terrainBasis: Retain the original standard6m Mapzen grid, native roads, central Golden Water stream, moat and every independent neighboring building. Coarse samples contain roof/terrain variation; individual occupied foundations extend below original local grades and selected hall terraces share an approximate datum. Ground openings are bounded by actual occupied model floors, never a whole palace-precinct ground slab. Replace only integrated native components; detailed coverage99.5percent/generalized bounded clipping. Failed loading retains originals; unloading restores terrain and releases model geometry. The three central halls/terraces share original plaza grade-6.288943978990174m; bounded stair-floor openings reveal the occupied steps without changing source samples.
